test.title: Section 2 · leaving a job and the company pension

texts.label: A
texts.title: Leaving the company: notice and your last weeks

paragraphs.text: Leaving the company: notice and your last weeks. If you decide to leave, you must give notice in writing to your manager. The length of notice depends on your contract: one week for staff in their probation period, one month for most permanent staff and three months for managers. Your manager will confirm your last day of work in writing within five working days of receiving your notice. In some cases the company may agree to a shorter notice period, but it is not obliged to do so.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Any holiday that you have not taken by your last day will be paid in your final salary. If you have taken more holiday than you have earned so far this year, the difference will be deducted. You may be asked to use some of your remaining holiday during the notice period, particularly if your manager feels that a long notice period is not needed to hand over your work.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Before you leave, you should prepare a handover document listing the tasks you are responsible for, the progress of current projects and the contacts that your replacement will need. Your manager will agree with you who should receive this document. All company property, including your laptop, mobile phone, pass and any keys, must be returned to the facilities team on or before your last day, and the cost of items that are not returned may be deducted from your final pay.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: All leavers are invited to an exit interview with a member of the human resources team, usually in the final week. The interview is voluntary, and what you say will not be shared with your manager in a form that identifies you. Answers are collected and reviewed twice a year to help the company understand why people leave. Your final salary and a statement of your earnings for the tax year will be sent to you after the next normal pay date.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Joining the workplace pension. All employees aged between twenty-two and the state pension age who earn more than a set minimum are enrolled in the company pension scheme automatically after three months of employment. Other employees may join if they wish by completing a form on the staff website. Membership is not compulsory: anyone who has been enrolled can opt out within one month and will have any contributions they have already paid returned to them in full.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Each month, employees pay five per cent of their salary into the scheme and the company adds a further four per cent. Staff may choose to pay more than five per cent, and for every extra one per cent they pay, the company adds a further half a per cent, up to a maximum company contribution of seven per cent. Contributions are taken from salary before tax, so the real cost to the employee is lower than the amount paid in.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The money is invested by an independent pension provider, not by the company itself. New members are placed in the default fund, which spreads investments across different types of assets and gradually moves into lower-risk investments as the member approaches retirement. Members who prefer to choose for themselves can select from twelve other funds through the provider’s website, and they can change funds at any time without charge.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Anyone who leaves the company keeps the pension they have built up, and it remains invested until they reach retirement age, although they can transfer it to another scheme if they wish. Each member receives an annual statement showing the value of their pension and an estimate of what it may pay. The human resources team runs a lunchtime presentation on the scheme every three months, and members can also book a free appointment with an adviser from the provider.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: Section 2 · leaving a job and the company pension

topic.en: Two workplace texts: notice and the last weeks before leaving, and the company pension scheme.
topic.kk: Екі жұмыс мәтіні: жұмыстан кетер алдындағы ескерту мерзімі мен соңғы апталар, компанияның зейнетақы бағдарламасы.
topic.ru: Два рабочих текста: срок уведомления и последние недели перед уходом, корпоративная пенсионная программа.

items.quote: one week for staff in their probation period
items.prompt: Staff on probation must give a month’s notice.

explanation.en: “one week for staff in their probation period” → FALSE. One month applies to most permanent staff.
explanation.kk: «one week for staff in their probation period» → FALSE. Бір ай — тұрақты қызметкерлердің көбіне арналған.
explanation.ru: «one week for staff in their probation period» → FALSE. Месяц — для большинства постоянных сотрудников.

items.quote: the company may agree to a shorter notice period, but it is not obliged to do so
items.prompt: The company must agree if someone asks to leave before their notice ends.

explanation.en: “may agree… but it is not obliged to do so” → FALSE: the company can agree but does not have to.
explanation.kk: «may agree… but it is not obliged to do so» → FALSE: компания келісуі мүмкін, бірақ міндетті емес.
explanation.ru: «may agree… but it is not obliged to do so» → FALSE: компания может согласиться, но не обязана.

items.quote: Any holiday that you have not taken by your last day will be paid in your final salary.
items.prompt: Leavers receive money for any holiday they have not used.

explanation.en: “Any holiday that you have not taken… will be paid in your final salary” → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «Any holiday that you have not taken… will be paid in your final salary» → TRUE: пайдаланылмаған демалыс ақшамен өтеледі.
explanation.ru: «Any holiday that you have not taken… will be paid in your final salary» → TRUE.

items.prompt: Most people who leave choose to attend an exit interview.

explanation.en: “The interview is voluntary” — how many leavers actually attend is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: «The interview is voluntary» — сұхбат ерікті екені айтылған; оған қанша адам келетіні айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: «The interview is voluntary» — сказано, что интервью добровольное; сколько людей на него приходит, не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: Your final salary and a statement of your earnings for the tax year will be sent to you after the next normal pay date.
items.prompt: Leavers are given a reference letter on their last day.

explanation.en: The final salary and a statement of earnings are mentioned; a reference letter is not → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Соңғы жалақы мен табыс туралы анықтама аталған; ұсыным хат туралы ештеңе жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Упомянуты последняя зарплата и справка о доходах после дня выплаты; о рекомендательном письме ничего нет → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Do the following statements agree with the information given in Text A? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

items.quote: Your manager will confirm your last day of work in writing within five working days of receiving your notice.
items.prompt: A written confirmation of the leaving date should arrive within ____ of the notice.

explanation.en: “within five working days of receiving your notice” → five working days. A week and a month are the notice periods themselves.
explanation.kk: «within five working days of receiving your notice» → five working days. Бір апта мен бір ай — ескерту мерзімінің өзі.
explanation.ru: «within five working days of receiving your notice» → five working days. Неделя и месяц — это сами сроки уведомления.

items.quote: the cost of items that are not returned may be deducted from your final pay
items.prompt: The cost of any items that are kept may be taken from the leaver’s ____.

explanation.en: “may be deducted from your final pay” → final pay. “Kept” = “not returned”.
explanation.kk: «may be deducted from your final pay» → final pay. «Kept» мен «not returned» — бір мағына.
explanation.ru: «may be deducted from your final pay» → final pay. «Kept» = «not returned».

items.prompt: The meeting with human resources normally takes place in the ____.

explanation.en: “usually in the final week” → final week. “Normally” = “usually”.
explanation.kk: «usually in the final week» → final week: сұхбат әдетте соңғы аптада өтеді.
explanation.ru: «usually in the final week» → final week. «Normally» = «usually».

groups.instruction: Complete the sentences below about Text A. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.

items.quote: will have any contributions they have already paid returned to them in full
items.prompt: What happens to an employee who leaves the scheme within the first month?

options.text: They must wait a year before joining again.
They get back everything they have paid in.
They are moved into the default fund.

explanation.en: “will have any contributions they have already paid returned to them in full” → B.
explanation.kk: «will have any contributions they have already paid returned to them in full» → B: төленген жарналар толық қайтарылады.
explanation.ru: «will have any contributions they have already paid returned to them in full» → B.

items.quote: for every extra one per cent they pay, the company adds a further half a per cent
items.prompt: An employee pays seven per cent of their salary into the scheme. How much does the company pay?

explanation.en: The base 4 % plus half a per cent for each extra per cent: 7 − 5 = 2 extra, 2 × 0.5 = 1 → 5 % (B). Seven per cent is the company’s maximum.
explanation.kk: Негізгі 4 % + әр артық пайызға жарты пайыз: 7 − 5 = 2 артық, 2 × 0,5 = 1 → 5 % (B). Жеті пайыз — компанияның ең жоғарғы үлесі.
explanation.ru: Базовые 4 % + по половине процента за каждый лишний процент: 7 − 5 = 2 лишних, 2 × 0,5 = 1 → 5 % (B). Семь процентов — это потолок компании.

groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D. The questions are about Text B.

items.quote: are enrolled in the company pension scheme automatically after three months of employment
items.prompt: Automatic membership begins after 11 ____ of employment

explanation.en: “automatically after three months of employment” → three months. In Text A three months is the managers’ notice period — a different rule.
explanation.kk: «automatically after three months of employment» → three months. Text A-дағы үш ай — басшылардың ескерту мерзімі, бұл басқа ереже.
explanation.ru: «automatically after three months of employment» → three months. В Text A три месяца — срок уведомления для руководителей, это другое правило.

items.quote: can select from twelve other funds
items.prompt: Number of alternatives to the default fund: 12 ____

explanation.en: “can select from twelve other funds” → twelve.
explanation.kk: «can select from twelve other funds» → twelve: әдепкі қордан бөлек он екі қор бар.
explanation.ru: «can select from twelve other funds» → twelve.

items.quote: members can also book a free appointment with an adviser from the provider
items.prompt: Personal guidance: meeting with an 13 ____ from the provider, at no cost

explanation.en: “a free appointment with an adviser from the provider” → adviser. Copy the spelling used in the text.
explanation.kk: «a free appointment with an adviser from the provider» → adviser. Мәтіндегідей жазыңыз, емлесіне назар аударыңыз: adviser.
explanation.ru: «a free appointment with an adviser from the provider» → adviser. Пишите так, как в тексте: adviser.
